meta.name: S.W.A.T. Exiles: Nueva generación
meta.description: Tras el fracaso de una misión de alto perfil, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson sale de su retiro forzoso para liderar una unidad experimental de SWAT de última oportunidad, compuesta por jóvenes reclutas impredecibles y sin experiencia. Hondo debe superar una brecha generacional, lidiar con personalidades contrapuestas y convertir a un escuadrón de forasteros en un equipo capaz de proteger la ciudad y salvar el programa que lo convirtió en quien es.

videos.title: Clean Entry
videos.overview: Hondo Harrelson gets one shot at redemption: build an S.W.A.T. unit from LA's overlooked talent; the team clicks under fire, but one of Hondo's own made a promise that has nothing to do with protecting S.W.A.T.

videos.title: Take the Shot
videos.overview: When the Exiles descend on a family business, a father-son power struggle boils over into a hostage standoff with deeper roots than turf; taking point as Scout for the first time, Malik faces an impossible call: one that will haunt him and the squad.

videos.title: Burn Zone
videos.overview: A manhunt pushes the Exiles to their breaking point; when a decision Hondo made to shield his squad from scrutiny comes back to bite him, he realizes someone close to him may know more than they're letting on.

videos.title: Get Clear
videos.overview: Called to account for a mission gone sideways, Hondo and the Exiles are forced to relive a hostage rescue disguised as an ICE raid; as the board digs for answers, Hondo uncovers footage that changes everything he thought he knew about his own squad.

videos.title: Molotov Cocktail Attire
videos.overview: When a foreign dignitary is targeted in a hit hidden inside a protest scheme, the Exiles race to identify the real threat; as a shocking murder causes chaos, Malik's growing web of secrets puts him on a collision course with the rest of the team.

videos.title: Hate Crime
videos.overview: When the FBI comes calling, Jude is pulled back undercover to infiltrate a white supremacist crew he spent years with; as his true history comes to light, the Exiles must reckon with what he did to survive and whether they can still trust him.

videos.title: The Project
videos.overview: A deadly new drug, smuggled inside donut deliveries, pulls the Exiles into an undercover operation; meanwhile, Malik's abrupt transfer sends shockwaves through the squad, but only Hondo and Ethan know just how deep undercover he's about to go.
